claim: 按作者的建议，每条研究结论只链接到一个最终数值已经足够，不需要知道该结果如何生成。

evidence.original_text: Whenever a result may be of potential interest, keep track of how it was produced. ... As a minimum, you should at least record sufficient details on programs, parameters, and manual procedures to allow yourself, in a year or so, to approximately reproduce the results.

reason: 文档明确要求对于每个结果都要记录其生成过程（Rule 1），并强调最低限度也要记录足够的细节以便重现结果，这与声称“只需链接到最终数值，不需要知道如何生成”相矛盾。
